messages:
Alex Chen: Starting a quick thread to align on DP outreach + feedback routing for the next beta wave. Goal: recruit 20 active partners in 6 weeks, balanced across PLG, mid-market, and regulated. Thoughts on channels and screening? :wave:
Mira Patel: Love it. Suggest we split outreach 60/30/10 — existing users / warm leads / open signups. Existing users convert fastest.
Samir Kapoor: +1. Also add a small enterprise quota (5) for dedicated/private use cases so we get infra/security asks early.
Joel Ramirez: For screening: ask 3 quick things in the form — "primary use case", "volume estimate (qps)" and "data sensitivity". Keep it one page.
Anya Volkova: Can we add a consent checkbox for sharing anonymized transcripts for evals and a short NDA option? Some partners will need it.
Alex Chen: Good call on NDA. Proposed screening snippet (short):
```
1) Company & contact
2) Primary use case
3) Expected monthly tokens / peak qps
4) Data sensitivity: public/internal/PII
5) Willing to do a 30–60 min interview + feedback sessions? (Y/N)
```
Mira Patel: That looks great. For incentives: credit + dedicated onboarding session. Maybe $1k credit + 2 hours SE time for enterprise?
Samir Kapoor: Keep credit tiers simple: Standard partners get $500 + 1 onboarding slot; Strategic (enterprise) get $2k + 4 onboarding hours + priority bugs.
Joel Ramirez: Routing feedback — recommend two channels: (1) weekly 45m sync with product + eng for active partners, (2) structured monthly survey + short qualitative interview. Route urgent bugs to eng-sre paging.
Anya Volkova: Agree. Also add an internal feedback triage doc with tags: quality, latency, cost, security. Use a shared Google Sheet or Notion with read/write for partners.
Alex Chen: Can DesignPartnerBot post a reminder for weekly syncs and collect pre-meeting prompts? @DesignPartnerBot can you add a weekly reminder flow?
DesignPartnerBot: will do — I'll create a recurring reminder and a short pre-sync form (3 fields). :robot_face:
Mira Patel: Success criteria proposal: 1) 80% of partners attend at least one sync, 2) median time-to-repro for partner-reported regressions < 48h, 3) two product changes shipped tied to partner feedback within the beta window.
Samir Kapoor: Add cost metrics: show expected token cost delta and a recommendation from Optimize for each partner by week 4.
Alex Chen: Timeline: Week 0-1 form + outreach, Week 2 onboarding + first sync, Weeks 3-6 active feedback + triage, Week 7 beta wrap & lessons. Sound OK?
Joel Ramirez: LGTM. Who owns list of invites and reminders?
Mira Patel: I'll own invites and onboarding. Samir will handle enterprise commits and SE time. Alex will own feedback triage and prioritization.
Anya Volkova: We'll need a privacy blurb for the form. I'll draft and share by EOD.
Alex Chen: Perfect. Follow-ups: Mira to publish form + outreach copy by tomorrow; DesignPartnerBot to set reminders; Anya to post privacy blurb. We'll reconvene Thu 11am to finalize the first batch. :calendar:
Mira Patel: I'll post the form link in #product when ready. :+1:
Samir Kapoor: Thanks, team. Small ask — add a Slack channel per cohort for real-time feedback, eg `#dp-cohort-2026-03`. Low friction wins.
Alex Chen: Good idea. Creating channel after first 5 signups. Closing notes: keep messaging short, emphasize low friction, and surface expectations. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
